messages:
Rae: quick spike in figma for a tighter trace header — link: https://www.figma.com/file/new/trace-header-spike
Rae: goals: make header scannable, default collapsed stack frames, and a single prominent action for users to grab a trace export
Omar: copy question: "Grab trace" vs "Download snapshot" vs "Export". Which maps to support language?
Jules: support prefers "Download snapshot". Engineers sometimes type "export" so maybe we show "Download snapshot" and smaller caption "(JSON export)"
Nina: accessibility: if the export size changes due to filters, announce via aria-live and update the accessible name of the button with new size e.g. "Download snapshot (~1.2MB)"
Rae: mock shows compact pill: "~1.2MB · 654 spans" right next to CTA, pill updates live. Also made correlation-id collapsible to first 6 chars + copy on hover
Omar: keyboard: propose shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+S to open export modal; also allow D then S sequence in toast for quick download. Need consistent docs.
Jules: backend note: including KV cache requires opt-in. show a checkbox in modal "Include KV (may be large)" and a size estimate recalculated before submit
a11y-bot: Automated check: contrast for pill low on frame 3 (contrast ratio 2.7:1). Recommend darken background or increase weight.
Nina: will update styles. Also add focus trap in export modal, role="dialog", esc to close, and move focus to modal heading on open
Rae: decision: primary CTA label = "Download snapshot" with inline small caption "JSON"; add kebab menu for formats, size pill with aria-live, collapsed correlation id with copy, modal for advanced options (KV opt-in + estimate), keyboard shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+S, and contrast fixes. I'll update figma and ping for a11y re-scan.
Omar: noted, I'll add telemetry events: export_requested, export_confirmed, export_kv_opt_in, export_size_estimate.
Rae: thanks team "
